purpose: Diagnostic replay of the historically reconstructible subset; not certification of the current full QVT ranking or buy_review decision policy
source: Frozen ui_score_historical_pit_v2 plus archived official TSETMC daily records and confirmed causal adjustment chain
financial_gates: All included raw fields finite; net_profit_ttm, revenue_ttm, roe, pe, pb, ps positive; debt ratio nonnegative; no neutral filling
population: Same complete factor set each date; symbols present in frozen panel and current general model family; no certified historical industry map, so family ranking only
normalization: Current QVT directions, 60/40 margin component blend, existing QVT P1/P99 bounds and midrank; no weight redistribution or rescaling to 100
timing: Reuse current QVT raw timing gates and identical start/end benchmark alignment; only dated records <= signal date, causal factors for corporate events <= signal date
selection: Top/bottom ten by score, tie symbol ascending; same complete eligible universe for every strategy; no profitability tuning
accounting: Reuse certified repair_accounting_v1 unchanged; monthly signal dates; execution first global session strictly after signal; failed targets cash, unsellable positions carried; no replacement
annualization: Actual elapsed days between first and final execution dates, including gaps; no synthetic missing months
limitations: 76 of 100 designed points only; no live status/risk-policy replay
Old financial snapshot is not recomputed with the new Codal corrections
Current identity/model family mapping and fixed archived universe imply survivorship limits
No historical sector-relative normalization or sector strength
Historical windows already used by earlier research; no untouched holdout and no optimization allowed
Price plus mechanical adjustments, not total shareholder return
Positive daily trades do not prove queue fills, slippage or portfolio capacity
Monthly observed drawdown may miss intramonth loss
